errors: First full run of fast_flux_run.py hit the 30-minute default background limit with no output (no per-layout progress line, no explicit timeout); rerun with timeout 5,400,000 ms and stderr progress.

First pruned kernel dropped 12,588 crossing pairs on layout 0 (a leg ending exactly at the other operator's hub: atan2(0,0)) and was slower than the dense kernel; found by profiling, fixed, regression-tested.
Blog post description was 167 characters (limit 160); check_post_frontmatter.py caught it, cascading to 174 site-builder test failures in run_workflow_locally.

doc_friction.issue: Says to use PY=$(python3 platform/ci/pyenv.py pytest numpy) when bare python3 lacks pytest; /usr/bin/python3.13 lacked pytest at first and pyenv.py returned that same path after installing it, which works but was not obvious from the docs.

Warns about the 120 s foreground timeout but not the 30-minute default for run_in_background; a 25-minute 4-core job with no progress output was killed at the limit. Pass an explicit timeout and print per-unit progress to stderr.

deviations.why: The registered method left 11x's same-operator sum unchanged; profiling layout 0 (after the first run failed) showed it was 55 of 88 s, so a symmetric rewrite was added post hoc.
deviations.did: Scored the predictions against the registered kernel and reported the symmetric version beside it, labelled post hoc in the log, README, summary and post.
deviations.result: Registered kernel 1.44x (3 of 5 predictions refuted); post hoc 3.06x, exact to 1.6e-15.

deviations.did: Disclosed in LOG.md; the commit history shows the registration (f056bf011) and the fix.
deviations.result: Tested fraction 0.338 instead of the wedge-ideal 0.177; P4 refuted on the implemented kernel.

certainty.tokens: high: summed from the per-request `usage` the API returned, as the transcript recorded it, deduplicated by message id
certainty.model: high: the `model` field on each API response, not the configured model
certainty.api_equivalent_usd: medium: measured tokens x list prices in prompts/pricing.json (as_of stated); an equivalent, not a charge: these runs are billed under a subscription
certainty.time: medium: from transcript timestamps; model time is request-to-response, tool time is call-to-result, time waiting on a person is excluded from active time
certainty.human_equivalent: low: the agent's own estimate of how long a competent person would take, with its basis written down; never measured

not_counted: requests the harness makes outside the transcript (context compaction summaries, title generation, safety classifiers), if any
transcripts lost when a cloud session moved to a new container: only files present in this container are read, so a resumed session can undercount
